reviews.title: Comfortable, stylish, but doesn’t charge.
reviews.comment: Comfortable mouse pad. Doesn't actually charge my G502x though. Doesn't matter, still keeping it.
reviews.author: Kanita

reviews.title: The rubber lining was a choice
reviews.comment: Just got it and it works. I will say, it is nice the use connector is near the mat. It was a heck of a choice however to have the hard rubber liner, especially where the wrist goes. Even making it rounder would have been nice. I will see how it goes later on. I wish you guys would release a mat to place over that could cover it.
reviews.author: Zach

reviews.title: Probably gonna use it
reviews.comment: Mat on top is not removable. Feels really cheap. Coil heats up. Probably fire hazard if you forgot and left some on top of the mouse pat.
reviews.author: charles

reviews.title: Value
reviews.comment: Very nice quality I would say better than the original. Can't go wrong with this replacement.
